craft_notes: Sthāyin: the Gospel-vose (this-tradition-hear: the text turns prophetic — and thanks to the gloss-chain fix this verse's T1 carries WHY: the freedom is BORN at once WITH the ears fixed). Sanskrit: idaṃ Śaṃkarāgama iti...tatsahajam ātmasātkṛtyā...dṛṣṭir unmiṣati → L4 keeps hear-tell pair, freedom-at-once, fixed eyes. Rows: row 2 (freedom-born→eyes fixed). Close: fixed (unmiṣati — but mine keeps unwinkering fixed: the open-eye stillness is the SIGN). Rejected: 'Shankaragama named' in English — killed: tradition kept (it's idam-Śaṃkarāgama as pointer, not our quote); 'instant liberation' — killed: freedom born-at-once kept (the born is v60's genesis-refrain again).

lines: Tradition this, Goddess, hear — rightly I tell:
even freedom born at once — eyes unwinkering fixed.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sampradāyam imam devi śṛṇu samyag vadāmy aham | kaivalyaṃ jāyate sadyo netrayoḥ stabdhamātrayoḥ

reads_against.argmap: When is freedom born? → Freedom is born at the very moment the gaze locks unwinkingly.
c1_essence: Eyes unwinkering fixed: freedom born at once.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra (stillness reached through force of attention)
